description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named SearchController that handles search and autocomplete functionalities for an e-commerce web application. It provides endpoints for searching products, retrieving autocomplete keywords, and displaying search results, utilizing various services such as search, product, category, and merchant store services.

classes.name: SearchController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling search-related HTTP requests, including auto-complete suggestions and product search results, integrating multiple services and populating view models.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for search keyword auto-complete. Retrieves merchant store info, invokes search service for keywords, returns results as JSON string.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Processes search requests for products based on input JSON query, returns a list of products, facets, and auxiliary data as a SearchProductList object.

methods.name: displaySearch
methods.description: Handles form submission from search box, prepares view template for displaying search results page.
